name: Drimage S3fs
description: A module that integrates S3FS for storing images on Amazon S3.
project_description:
This module is a fork of the Drimage module and should work as a drop-in replacement, however, it uses system file paths and falls back on the dynamic generation.

For more info, please check the original issue https://www.drupal.org/project/drimage/issues/3283460 

 Post-Installation 
 The module will disable Drimage and update the field formatters to use the new widget.

If using files to manage your configuration you will need to export the files and commit it to your version control repository.
